title: .respawnpack/runtime/session-<sessionId>.json — the boot baseline a Stop decision subtracts
description: Written ONCE per session by hooks/_runtime.js captureBaseline(), from hooks/session-routing-nudge.js. GITIGNORED. ⛔ THE PER-FILE DIGESTS ARE THE WHOLE POINT, and a name list cannot give them: the run-A case is a file already dirty at boot and edited AGAIN during the session — its name is in both lists, and only its content digest moves. Carries no schemaVersion; the record is rewritten on the next boot and never migrated, so a version field would have nothing to gate.

files.description: Keys are PREFIXED: W: worktree diff chunk · S: staged diff chunk · U: untracked file content. The prefix is what keeps a staged and an unstaged edit to one path distinguishable.
